annotations.title: Can I sell this on Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop or Etsy?

description: Use this when a seller asks whether they can sell a product on Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop or Etsy, to stores, or on their own website, and what each will ask for: "can I sell toys on Amazon?", "requirements for selling supplements on Amazon", "how do I get approved (ungated) to sell kids' clothes?", "Amazon asked for compliance documents, what do I send?", "can I sell a stroller on Etsy?". Give the product in the seller's words and the channels. It returns closed or restricted doors first, then each channel's own rules for that product and the US federal law that applies everywhere, each line numbered to its source with the page's date and the day it was read. It first needs the certificate answer for the product, so it may return questions instead: ask the seller all of them and call again with their answers. Do not use for duties, tariffs or customs classification (HS or HTS codes), for marketplaces outside the US (Amazon UK, Amazon.ca or EU sites, for example), or to promise that a listing will be approved.

answers.description: The seller's answers to the questions an earlier call listed: answer key → one of that question's values, exactly as listed. Only pass what the seller actually said.

channels.description: Where the seller will sell, in the United States only: amazon (amazon.com, not Amazon UK, Amazon.ca or other countries), walmart, tiktok (TikTok Shop US), etsy, wholesale (to US stores), own (their own website, selling in the US). If the seller is selling outside the US, do not call this tool.

fda_kind.description: Only when an earlier call listed the answer key `fda_tap`: the value the seller chose.

made_for_children.description: Whether the product is made mainly for children 12 or under. Leave it out unless the seller said.

other_kind.description: Only when an earlier call listed the answer key `other_tap`: the value the seller chose.

product.description: The product in the seller's own words, e.g. "plush teddy bear", "kids rain boots", "bluetooth speaker", "ceramic coffee mug".
